question: Which specific seed syllables must be uttered together in this mantra sequence?
premises: Tāra, vāgbhava, and lakṣmī are specified
The syllables hrīṃ, hrīṃ, and huṃ are specified
All are to be uttered together
inference: One should utter tāra, vāgbhava, lakṣmī, and hrīṃ-hrīṃ-huṃ in sequence.
plain_english: One should utter tāra, vāgbhava, lakṣmī, and hrīṃ, hrīṃ, huṃ.
